narrative: This daily brief synthesizes recent advancements across technology, AI, infrastructure, and science. Key developments include Big Tech's push for AI regulation, significant investments in AI and cloud infrastructure, and progress in space science and autonomous systems. The tech landscape shows a strong focus on AI integration and expansion across various sectors.

highlights.title: Big Tech’s desperate last push at AI regulation
highlights.whyItMatters: Big Tech lobbies for comprehensive federal AI laws to preempt a fragmented state-by-state regulatory approach.

highlights.title: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-34 Dragon Returns Packed with Space Station Science
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX Dragon spacecraft returns with critical biological and materials samples, advancing NASA’s space research.

highlights.title: How TimescaleDB compresses time-series data
highlights.whyItMatters: An in-depth article explores the compression techniques used by TimescaleDB for efficient time-series data management.

highlights.title: Salesforce acquires AI customer service platform Fin for $3.6 billion
highlights.whyItMatters: Salesforce acquires Fin to enhance its Agentforce platform, aiming to improve AI-driven customer service automation.

highlights.title: A satellite just learned to find things on its own — here’s what that means
highlights.whyItMatters: For the first time, an Earth observation satellite autonomously identified its targets, signaling a leap in autonomous systems.

highlights.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS FinOps Agent in preview, Gemma 4 on Bedrock, Kiro Pro Max, and more (June 15, 2026)
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS introduces new AI and infrastructure services, including a FinOps Agent and Gemma 4 on Bedrock, at the AWS Summit.

highlights.title: Introducing the OpenAI Partner Network
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI launches a $150M partner network to accelerate enterprise AI adoption and deployment globally.
